simple.meaning: עִוֵּר (ʻivvêr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “blind (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H5787. ivver עִוֵּר adjective blind ; — only absolute ׳ע Exod 4:11 +, plural עִיְרִים 2Sam 5:6 +, feminine עִוְרוֺת Isa 42:7 ; (with article הָעִוֵּר Deut 28:29 , elsewhere ׳הַע Baer Ginsb; van d. H. לָעִוֵּר Job 29:15 , הָעִוְרִים 2Sam 5:6 , 8 ; Isa 42:18 ); — blind , usually as substantive = the blind: 1 literally, physically blind: a. of men Exod 4:11 (J; opposed to מִּקֵּחַ ), 2Sam 5:6 , 8 (twice in verse); Lev 19:14 (H), Deut 27:18 ; Jer 31:8 ; Job 29:15 ; in simile Deut 28:29 ; Zeph 1:17 ; Isa 59:10 , compare Lam 4:14 (apposition); as adjective attribute ע ׳אִישׁ Lev 21:18 (H). b. of sacrifice animal Deut 15:21 ; Mal 1:8 . 2 figurative, a. of the helpless, groping Isa 29:18 ; 35:5 ; 42:16 ; Psa 146:8 ; as adjective attribute, עִוְרוֺת עֵינַיִם Isa 42:7 . b. of the dull, unreceptive , Isa 42:18-19 , (3 t. in verse) (but 42:19 c read חֵרֵשׁ q. v.); as adjective attributive עִוֵּר עַם 43:8 ; as predicate 56:10 .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
“ ‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.
‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’
You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here;” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”
I was eyes to the blind,
Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind.
In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.
Then the eyes of the blind will be opened,
to open the blind eyes,
I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know.
“Hear, you deaf,
Who is blind, but my servant?
Who is blind, but my servant?
Who is blind, but my servant?
Bring out the blind people who have eyes,
His watchmen are blind.
We grope for the wall like the blind.
Behold, I will bring them from the north country,
They wander as blind men in the streets.
I will bring distress on men, that they will walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Yahweh, and their blood will be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.

When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.
